dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Its name is Sag? Oh, what a nice puppy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like search and rescue dogs?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Of course. I love obedient puppies, especially the ones that let you rub their belly and look at you with their little sparkling eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Actually, I've always wanted to get a dog. Not only could it help keep me in a good mood, but it could also intimidate others when need be.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But if I got a dog, it'd be too much hassle to groom it and clean up after it all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: That's the trouble with pets. I suppose I'm not really suited to have one.
